why: The anti-slop mechanical sweep, one job on fabrikalfa/antislop-mechanical from origin/main at 9186e6c, in next/ and our tooling. Of the ten taken anti-slop rules only anti-slop/require-readable-spacing has an autofix (vendor/anti-slop/src/rules/require-readable-spacing.ts wraps the vendored padding-line-between-statements, the only file under vendor/anti-slop/src with a fixer), so it is the one rule swept. Met: 15,791 hits in 928 files over the scope, counted by a scratch run of the rule alone, matched against the zero lock's folders and the config's ignore list. The rule was turned on over the four whole-scope globs and pnpm format run twice; the diff was then 15,795 added lines and 0 removed in the swept files, every added line blank, so the fixer added blank lines and nothing else (no import moved, no comment lost). The 26 files of pull request 1366's diff that it touched were reverted by name, leaving 1,074 hits, all in those 26 files. 902 files keep 14,717 added blank lines. The first pnpm format run's lint --fix pass pruned 82 entries from agents-ledger.json and 10 from next-ledger.json and reported 92 blocking findings; a plain lint.ts run over the same tree then reported 0 blocking with every entry still matched, so the two ledgers were restored from git and the second pnpm format left them alone. Three tests that lint planted files in a now-locked folder through the real config failed and were changed on the test side only: oxlint-plugins/plants.test.ts T930 L6 (its planted tried.ts is now spaced), next/apps/fabrika/src/exam/one-store-hook.integration.test.ts's crash case (its other-calls.ts plant is now spaced, same calls), and oxlint-plugins/padding-line-between-statements.test.ts's two properties, whose CLI fix pass now runs our rule alone with a temp config, since in oxlint-plugins/ the real config also runs anti-slop's fixer; the firing check still runs the repo's own config. Decision 0021 gains its dated amendment and oxlint-plugins/README.md its text and count.
